assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Triangle ABC with the interior point P joined to A, B and C; BP extended meets AC at D. O is the apex of an equilateral triangle on AB outside ABC (grey sides OA, OB), with a dotted arc of the circle centred at O through A, P and B. The blue segment OP, the blue dashed segment OD and the red segment PC form, with DC, the parallelogram PODC.

difficulty_rationale: An adventitious-angle problem: the synthetic solution needs the circumcentre of ABP (an equilateral triangle on AB) and a hidden parallelogram; with trigonometric Ceva it is a moderate calculation.
